results.title: The Runner
results.overview: An overworked Production Assistant fights to survive a chaotic day on set.

results.title: The Legend of Captain Scarlet
results.overview: Inspired by the Super Space Theatre compilations of the 1980s. An exclusive new feature-length New Captain Scarlet movie experience.

results.title: Red Lady With Two Guns
results.overview: On her wedding day in 1938, Gao Shengnan saw her husband brutally murdered by the Japanese army and her elders slaughtered. Taking up arms to rally a resistance force, she struck repeatedly at the invaders, earning widespread renown; later, guided by the Eighth Route Army, she resolved to join the revolution. When the Japanese attempted to lure her into a trap, she faced the enemy alone, risking her life to ensure the safety of her fellow villagers. At the critical moment, the Eighth Route Army launched a surprise attack and wiped out the enemy, but Gao Shengnan lay bloodied on the battlefield—her fate hanging in the balance...

results.title: A Burial
results.overview: A struggling photographer’s life is upended when he receives the news of his wife’s pregnancy. As his mental state deteriorates he becomes increasingly violent and dangerous and he struggles desperately to hide a heinous crime while haunted by a mysterious stranger who knows too much. The pressure builds, and his relationships decay, until he must confront his own darkness, or become it.

results.title: See Me
results.overview: When his father refuses to stop reaching out, a young man groomed online at twelve must decide whether to finally let someone see what was left behind.

results.title: Night of the Screaming Terror
results.overview: Night Of The Screaming Terror follows Dr Redfern as he visits St Peters mental asylum for the criminally insane. Inside he meets the eccentric Dr Mountford and his group of special patients. Each one with a bizarre and terrifying reason for their eternal detainment in the dark corridors of the asylum.

results.title: Celebrity Crime Scene: Princess Diana
results.overview: Follows investigators examining theories surrounding Princess Diana's death, including mysterious vehicles in the tunnel and allegations of powerful forces determined to silence her.

results.title: Deadline
results.overview: When writer’s block threatens his career, Tómas, a screenwriter searches for a shortcut before time runs out.

results.title: The Renaissance of Oddity Todd
results.overview: In a world ruled by the authoritarian World Collective, the secretive Sonus master the power of vibration. When a deeper evil emerges, only a Sonus with a cryptic past can save humanity from a dark reckoning.

results.title: Gladiator Baby
results.overview: A young girl and a young boy must fight for their goals to pave the way for their dreams — but only one of them can get closer to their destination, and only if they are willing to destroy the other’s dream in the gamble of ambition.

results.title: Behind the Reflection
results.overview: A woman struggles with their identity, leading to a life of addiction, alcoholism and violence. A gritty drama based on the true life of Rozelle Gemma.

results.title: 100 Years of Marilyn Monroe
results.overview: An exploration of Marilyn Monroe's life, legacy, and lasting impact a century after her birth, revealing the complex woman behind the iconic image.

results.title: The Long Con
results.overview: A little desert motel. A runaway bride. A grifter lover. A suitcase full of trouble.

results.title: Crystal Lake Girls
results.overview: When young, hot, nubile Madison agrees to spend the summer at the “Crystal Lake Retreat”, a new cozy institution for troubled young women instead of prison, she thinks her troubles are over. Girl fights and lecherous guards? No problem. However, for poor Madison, that is when the real trouble begins as this summer marks the 30th Anniversary of Jason’s murderous killing spree on Friday the 13th. Now Madison is locked in with seven other women as they are hunted by a serial killer known only as “the President”, several guards who are pigs, one head honcho who is a hottie and a couple of yahoos for the law.  Can she survive or will she become another victim?

results.title: This Is Private
results.overview: A stripper cunningly decides to use her private dances as therapy sessions in order to prevail in her collegiate psychology class.

results.title: Make Up Sex
results.overview: After a year of dating, a young couple explores the boundaries of what Make Up Sex can do for their relationship. Jeremy, not looking for confrontation, agrees to give it a try as they gear up to start that one fight worth making up over.

results.title: Das Höhenphänomen
results.overview: When Sandra was a child, global crises triggered deep insecurity in her. She experienced the so-called HPP or high place phenomenon: the eerie thought of jumping from a great height. As an adult, the sensation returns with the outbreak of the war in Ukraine.

results.title: Riptides
results.overview: A daughter's diabolical plan to preserve her father's legacy is torpedoed by a demented boogie boarder on a self-help bender.

results.title: La Vie de Maria Manuela
results.overview: A fearless young artist, Maria Manuela refuses to conform. Filmed over the course of four years by her closest friend, we follow her journey of self-discovery, creativity, and the ups and downs of finding her place in the world.
